landing.eyebrow: A1 · A2 · B1 · B2 · Goethe and telc formats
landing.lede: The real structure of the Goethe-Zertifikat and telc Deutsch exams: modules, Teile, timers and scoring. Your mistakes go into the Fehlerbuch, words move into a review schedule — so you always know what to work on before exam day.
landing.ctaNote: No password needed. Works without an account too — results stay in your browser.
landing.stat1Label: complete exam sets: Goethe A1 · A2, telc B1 · B2
landing.stat2Label: exam items, each with an explanation
landing.stat3Label: topic practice questions, A1 to B2
landing.formatsTitle: Every exam with its own rules
landing.formatsBody: Seven independent sets per format. Module timings, how often a listening text plays, point weights and the pass mark follow the official structure: telc counts the written and oral parts separately, Goethe uses the overall score.
landing.howTitle: Three steps, useful from day one
landing.step1Body: A full exam from A1 to B2, or a short practice run by topic. Modules can be taken one at a time.
landing.step2Body: The module timer runs, the audio plays only as often as the exam allows, and your answer sheet is scored at the end.
landing.step3Body: Every mistake lands in the Fehlerbuch with an explanation, your weakest topic is highlighted, and words move into review.
landing.f1Body: Lesen 25–60 minutes, Hören at the pace of the audio, Schreiben 20–30 minutes. When time runs out, the module ends automatically.
landing.f2Body: Your browser reads the dialogues in German, a separate voice per speaker — once or twice, depending on the Teil.
landing.f3Body: Mistakes from exams and practice in one place: the question, your answer, the correct one and why.
landing.f4Body: 32 thematic sets with Leitner boxes: words you know come back later, words you don't come back sooner.
landing.f5Body: Raw points are converted by module weight, and the result follows the official scale: ausreichend, gut, sehr gut.
landing.f6Body: No password: tap “Start” in the bot. Results link to your account and sync across devices.
landing.finalTitle: Do you have an exam date?
landing.finalBody: Enter it and the app counts the days left and shows a weekly plan. Take your first mock exam today.
landing.finalNote: Creating an account takes 10 seconds. No email, no password.
landing.disclaimer: This is an independent practice app — it is not affiliated with the Goethe-Institut or telc and does not replace an official exam. Only the publicly known structure was taken from the official exams (modules, number of Teile, task types, timings and point distribution); all texts, dialogues and tasks were written for this app.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This app is a study tool. Below is what data is collected, why it's needed and how you can delete it.
privacy.s1Body: If you sign in with Telegram, the bot passes on the following, and it is linked to your account:
privacy.s1i1: Your Telegram ID, first name and (if you have one) username — so we can recognise you.
privacy.s1i2: Your progress: exam results, Fehlerbuch, vocabulary review state and settings.
privacy.s1i3: Exam date and target level — if you enter them yourself.
privacy.s2Body: We never ask for an email address, phone number or password — we simply don't have them. We can't see your Telegram chats either: the bot only receives the message sent when you tap “Start”. Voice recordings from the Sprechen exercise stay on your device and are never sent to the server.
privacy.s3i1: In your browser — without an account, everything stays there and nowhere else.
privacy.s3i2: On the server (Supabase, Europe) — only if you're signed in with Telegram, so your progress syncs across devices.
privacy.s4Body: Your data is never sold to third parties and never used for advertising. Only the app server can reach the database; direct access from the browser is blocked.
privacy.s5Body: If you want your account and all data deleted, message the bot — we'll delete it. Data in your browser you can remove yourself at any time by clearing the site data.
privacy.s6Body: The app is not affiliated with the Goethe-Institut or telc and does not replace an official exam. Only the publicly known structure was adopted; all texts and tasks were written for this app.
